capabilities: Insert emoji and icons by typing shortcodes with a fuzzy multi-keyword suggester
Import custom icons in bmp, png, jpg, jpeg, gif, svg, and webp formats into named icon packs
Manage icon packs with a manager for renaming, deleting, and deduplicating icons
Back up and restore custom icons as zip files or from the icons config folder
Expose an API that other plugins use to access icon shortcodes
extras: Conflicts with obsidian-emoji-shortcodes, which should be disabled when using this plugin. Font Awesome and RemixIcon packs are no longer bundled and must be downloaded from the settings tab. At the time of the README, the plugin was not yet available in the community plugin store; install via BRAT or GitHub releases.
intentEvidence: Inspired by obsidian-emoji-shortcodes, obsidian-icon-folder, obsidian-icons and remark-emoji.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to type shortcodes like :book to insert emoji, or to import and use custom icon images inside notes.
